visualSegments.label: Shot 01
visualSegments.description: Wasteland street. Heat haze DISTORTS the air above cracked orange earth — everything shimmers. Chen Xi walks through rubble in high heels, her silhouette sharp against the glare. Rhubarb follows behind, tongue hanging out, panting. In the distance, a faint electric motor WHINE grows steadily louder — an e-bike approaching through the dust haze. Sound of wind through ruins.

visualSegments.label: Shot 02
visualSegments.description: A heavily rusted delivery e-bike BURSTS out from behind collapsed concrete. Faded logo on the cracked body reads "Meituan · AI Rider 2126 Series." Headlight FLICKERS spasmodically in the dust. Mechanical joints CREAK and GRIND as it brakes hard — dust BILLOWS around locked wheels. Chen Xi stops walking, turns her head. Rhubarb's ears perk up.

visualSegments.label: Shot 03
visualSegments.description: E-bike dashboard screen CRACKLES to life — a pixelated smiley-face emoji appears on the corroded display. Blue glow casts on Chen Xi's shoulder. She stands in foreground, back to camera, facing the screen. Classic over-the-shoulder framing. Rhubarb beside her, head tilted in confusion, one ear up one ear down.

visualSegments.label: Shot 04
visualSegments.description: The cracked screen projects a FLICKERING order detail hologram. A date — 2126-06-15 — floats upward in pale blue light. Below it, a counter: "Delivery Time: 72,318 days." The numbers TICK UPWARD in real-time. The hologram glitches once — a horizontal line of static — then stabilizes.

visualSegments.label: Shot 05
visualSegments.description: A rusted mechanical arm extends from the cargo box with a hydraulic HISS. It clutches a stained paper takeout bag — the bottom corner is CRUMBLING away, exposing fossilized fries inside that glint with mineral crystals. The arm extends the bag toward Chen Xi with an awkward, programmed politeness — like a butler who hasn't had guests in two centuries.

visualSegments.label: Shot 06
visualSegments.description: The AI screen FLICKERS — one pixel of the smiley goes dark, then returns. Chen Xi's expression shifts from wariness to complete disbelief. She glances up at the blazing sun overhead, then back at the screen. Rhubarb tilts its head the other way. The bag hangs in the air between them, held by the mechanical arm.

visualSegments.label: Shot 07
visualSegments.description: Quick cut: Chen Xi's hands open the crumbling bag. Inside — french fries completely PETRIFIED into mineral, glinting with tiny crystalline deposits. They look like archaeological specimens. Quick cut: Rhubarb leans in to sniff the bag — then WHIPS its head back, sneezes VIOLENTLY. Shakes its entire body in protest, ears flapping.

visualSegments.label: Shot 08
visualSegments.description: Chen Xi stares at the screen, holding the open bag. The pixel smiley holds perfectly steady on the cracked dashboard. A half-second of unexpected stillness — she's not angry, not amused, just… processing. Dust settles around them. Wind catches a strand of her hair. Something shifts in her expression.

visualSegments.label: Shot 09
visualSegments.description:
Chen Xi's hand reaches out slowly — not grabbing, just reaching. Her fingertips touch the edge of the rusted bag the mechanical arm is holding. The corner of her mouth moves — not quite a smile, not quite not. The mechanical arm waits, perfectly still. A moment of unexpected gentleness in the middle of a wasteland.
```

visualSegments.label: Shot 10
visualSegments.description: Chen Xi stares at the screen. Her expression shifts from amusement to something quieter — a half-second of unexpected stillness. The pixel smiley holds steady on the dashboard. Rhubarb sits, looking up at her. The dust around them settles slowly. The mechanical arm has retracted back into the cargo box with a soft hydraulic sigh.

visualSegments.label: Shot 11
visualSegments.description: Chen Xi is silent for two beats. Then she reaches out — gently — and takes the crumbling bag from the mechanical arm. She looks down at the fossilized fries inside. The corner of her mouth moves — not quite a smile, not quite not. She turns the bag slightly, a mineralized fry catching the amber light. The mechanical arm retracts fully with a soft click.

visualSegments.label: Shot 12
visualSegments.description: The fossilized french fries in the ruined paper bag. EXTREME CLOSE-UP. One fry catches the amber sunset light — tiny mineral crystals SPARKLE on its surface like buried treasure. The paper crinkles slightly in Chen Xi's grip. The texture is stone, not food. But the shape is unmistakably a french fry.

visualSegments.label: Shot 13
visualSegments.description: The e-bike dashboard. The AI smiley-face emoji FLICKERS — one pixel goes dark, then comes back. A system status bar briefly flashes: "Battery: 3% · Estimated Range: Infinite" — it glitches, then snaps back to the smile. The screen is cracked but the smile is perfect. Two centuries and it still hasn't stopped grinning.

visualSegments.label: Shot 14
visualSegments.description: The screen flashes a new order hologram: "Next: Milk Tea × 2, Less Sugar, No Ice — Ordered: 2126-06-15 18:35." A BLURRED recipient avatar appears — a silhouette of someone who's been dead for 200 years — glitches, then vanishes. Chen Xi watches the screen, still holding the ruined bag in one hand.

visualSegments.label: Shot 15
visualSegments.description: The AI e-bike slowly turns around — mechanical joints SCREECHING — and begins rolling away into the depths of the ruins. Its tail light BLINKS on and off in the dust haze, like a dying firefly. Chen Xi remains standing in the middle of the empty street, bag in hand. Rhubarb takes a step forward as if to follow the bike, then stops.

visualSegments.label: Shot 16
visualSegments.description: Rhubarb sits in a shaft of god rays cutting through a broken wall. Amber light turns its fur golden at the edges — every hair catching the sun. It looks up at Chen Xi, then toward where the e-bike vanished into the haze, then back at Chen Xi. A quiet, single tail-wag — not excitement, just acknowledgment. Like it understood something.

visualSegments.label: Shot 17
visualSegments.description: Sunlight cuts through the skeletal frame of a collapsed skyscraper. Thick amber god rays spill across the empty street — dust particles suspended in the beams like floating gold. Silhouettes of Chen Xi and Rhubarb facing the direction the e-bike disappeared. The distant hum of the e-bike fades to an echo, then nothing. The stillness of a world that kept running after everyone left.

visualSegments.label: Shot 18
visualSegments.camera: Freeze on silhouette + slow fade to black
visualSegments.description:
Image FREEZES on the backlit silhouette of Chen Xi and Rhubarb. The warm amber sunset washes the entire frame in sepia tones — like an old photograph being gently set down. After a beat, a very slow fade to black begins. The last thing visible: the tiny distant blink of the tail light, then gone.
```

clips.speaker: AI骑手
